accounts.usernameHint: Use letters a–z, numbers, dots, underscores and hyphens; include at least one letter or number.
accounts.preHashedPassword: A password with a supported hash-scheme prefix is stored as given.

assignment.missing: This assigned domain no longer exists.
assignment.catchAll: This is a non-domain assignment from the classic interface; it does not grant access to real domains.

confirm.rename: Rename {username} to {next}? Existing sessions and acting sessions end. API keys are revoked permanently. Passkeys and second factors follow the new name.
confirm.renameOwn: Rename your account from {username} to {next}? This browser stays signed in under the new name. Other sessions end and API keys are revoked permanently.
confirm.deactivate: Deactivate {username}? This account cannot sign in and its current sessions and API keys stop working until it is activated again.
confirm.deactivateOwn: Deactivate your account {username}? This browser will be signed out. Another active administrator must activate your account before you can sign in again.
confirm.removeDomainAdmin: Remove {username}, assigned to {domains}? API keys are revoked permanently, passkeys and second factors are removed, and sessions end. Domains and mailboxes remain.
confirm.removeAdmin: Remove administrator {username}? API keys are revoked permanently, passkeys and second factors are removed, and sessions end. Domains and mailboxes remain.
confirm.suspend: Suspend second factors for {username}? Existing factors stop working until the next successful password sign-in. Passkeys remain available.

bulk.ownExcluded: Your own account was left out of this action.
bulk.delete: Remove {count} accounts? API keys are revoked permanently, passkeys and second factors are removed, and sessions end. Domains and mailboxes remain.
bulk.deactivate: Deactivate {count} accounts? Their sessions end and they cannot sign in until activated again.
bulk.suspendSecondFactors: Suspend second factors for {count} accounts? Passkeys remain available.

empty.domainAdmin: Domain administrators manage mailboxes and aliases in the domains assigned to them.
